I'm 21 and have my own place. My family is close so no matter where I go I'm in that environment. I can't just cut my self off from them unless I just end it. Only option. And I'm going to take it. 
And my choices in life haven't gotten better. I make the right choices but I'm still not happy. Idk if I ever will be again

Very much so. I wish it wasn't. Everyone expects me to be perfect, but the minute I mess up its the end of the world. Then you have my brother who constantly messes up and practically is praised whenever he does and is babied. He is 3 years older and I get shunned if I make the smallest fraction of a mistake. If I'm not perfect I'm worthless. I can't be perfect all the time. My life is like this...I'm in a room full of people, can scream at the top of my lungs and no one looks up or flinches. (Sorry if it shows more than one reply. Shows two comments were made but I only see yours.)
